items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 81:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Mazal of the name AB? The Mochin in the stature of AB that Aba and Ima receive do not come out except upon the MAN of the beard of AA, which are the aspect of the first restriction, as is known. And therefore the stature of AB of Aba and Ima is called by the name “the Mazal of the name AB”, meaning the stature of AB that comes out upon the MAN of the Mazal. (Item 178).
